completion_data.completion_summary: Closed the Sapience extraction measurement series at three real passes plus a read-only accrual sample and vault-content audit, then decided all four candidate outcomes from the recorded figures: adding includeAgentSessions, adjusting the chunk cap/backfill, and turning on backgroundSync were each rejected on measured grounds, and leaving the current manual, 50-chunk, no-timer arrangement unchanged was selected. No configuration file was modified; Phase 7 closed COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS naming the decision record as the reason.

memory_candidates.content: verify-touched.sh, run against touched paths confined to specs/** in a deploy-consumer repo (no agent-system/ present), falls into its OWED/full-sweep fallback (no suite maps to specs/** paths) and runs the complete run-all.sh test battery. This surfaces pre-existing 'mode=source-store' test failures (missing agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/*.sh) that are structural to this repo and unrelated to the touched paths -- pass --task-dir to get the owed paths durably recorded, and expect this fallback whenever a dispatch's only touched files are under specs/**.

Sapience's sapience pending counter (the unreviewed-review queue) only ever changes during an extraction pass; across every inter-pass reading in a 6-day, 6-reading measurement series it stayed perfectly flat with no organic growth. This makes 'pending' a reliable signal of pass-driven staging alone, decoupled from Available-on-disk's continuous transcript accrual.

Sapience's non-overridable subagent/harness-started transcript filter removes roughly 30x more than its overridable headless/agent filter, stable in a narrow 30.13x-31.45x band across 6 independent coverage readings taken days apart on an orchestration-heavy workflow. SAPIENCE_INCLUDE_HEADLESS=1 cannot touch the dominant filter at all, so widening that one override has limited effect on total coverage.

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience pending-queue growth mechanism
sapience_notes.value: sapience pending only changes when an extraction pass runs; it stays perfectly flat between passes with zero organic growth, confirmed across 6 readings spanning 6 days in a dedicated measurement series on this machine.

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience two-filter asymmetry
sapience_notes.value: The non-overridable subagent/harness-started filter removes roughly 30x more transcripts than the overridable headless/agent filter, stable in a 30.13x-31.45x band across 6 independent coverage readings on this machine's orchestration-heavy workflow.

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience MAX_CHUNKS throughput and daily cap
sapience_notes.value: MAX_CHUNKS=50 is not a wall-clock bottleneck (three real passes ran 22-48 minutes each on the anthropic backend), and the daily 2000-object cap does not truncate a run -- one pass staged 2051 objects past the cap with no early stop or dropped chunk observed in the journal.

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience per-pass cost signal
sapience_notes.value: No per-pass dollar or token cost figure is exposed anywhere in the sapience client's own output (stats, coverage, or the systemd journal) on the anthropic backend; only wall clock and CPU time are available, confirmed across three independent extraction passes.

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience vault ko_type homogenization
sapience_notes.value: Every one of 3757 records in a sampled pending_kos.jsonl queue carried ko_type: insight with no other value ever observed, so the client's storage format preserves no categorical distinction between decisions, measured facts, corrections, and constraints at staging time.

sapience_notes.subject: Sapience folder-selection anomaly for abood
sapience_notes.value: Despite abood being one of four folders selected for capture, zero records attributed to the abood project appeared anywhere in a 3757-record pending queue across a full measurement series -- cause unestablished.

sapience_notes.subject: verify-touched.sh OWED fallback on specs-only touched paths
sapience_notes.value: Running verify-touched.sh with touched paths confined to specs/** triggers its OWED/full-sweep fallback (no suite maps to specs/** paths), which runs the complete run-all.sh test battery and can surface pre-existing source-store-only test failures in a repository that lacks agent-system/ entirely (a deploy-consumer repo).
